panels.title: Measured floor area
panels.description: What the robot believes the room measures. Ground truth for the simulated rectangular room is 27.0 m².

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_estimate" and r._field == "area_m2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> last()

panels.title: Boundary closed
panels.description: Whether the robot has completed a full circuit of the walls. Until it has, the area is a lower bound rather than a measurement.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_estimate" and r._field == "is_closed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))

panels.title: Area estimate converging
panels.description: The area estimate should settle as the robot completes its circuit. A figure still climbing means the boundary is not closed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "room_estimate" and r._field == "area_m2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Sim-to-real divergence
panels.description: How far the real robot has drifted from where perfect, slip-free execution of the same commands would have put it. This is the headline research number.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "twin_gap" and r._field == "position_error_m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Pose uncertainty
panels.description: One-sigma error the filter reports. Above 0.5 m new scans stop being written into the map.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_pose" and (r._field == "std_x_m" or r._field == "std_y_m"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: GNSS — why it does not draw the map

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_status" and r._field == "satellites")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> last()

panels.title: HDOP
panels.description: Horizontal dilution of precision. Above 2.0 the fix is refused for position correction — indoors it is typically 6 to 25.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_status" and r._field == "hdop")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> last()

panels.title: Fixes usable for positioning
panels.description: 1 when a fix passes the accuracy gate, 0 otherwise. Indoors this stays flat at zero, which is the point: GPS georeferences the map, it does not draw it.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_status" and r._field == "usable")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Range sensors
panels.description: Distance to the nearest wall on each sensor. A reading pinned at max range means no echo returned.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_sensors" and r._field =~ /^range_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "roommapper")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "robot_pose" and r._field == "distance_travelled_m")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.robot_id == "${robot}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
